requirements.evidence: Two parts: the existing hex base piece (piece at 0,0,0, full) and one full-depth bin (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full) seated in its cell. check_build is ok with meshClash clear and no rule errors.
bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full sits in the base cell at 0,0,0. The bin drops in and hangs on its rim.

finish.summary: The smallest build is the single hex base cell with one full-depth bin in it, two parts total.
